text: Please call Stella. Ask her to bring these things with her fro-fro-from the store: six spoons of fresh snow peas, s-five thick slabs of a blue cheese, and maybe a snack for her brother Bob. We also need a small plastic snake and a big toy frog for the kids. She can, uh, scoop these things into three wet bags, and we wi- we will go meet her Wednesday at the train station.
